newsitem.title: KUWAIT: Kuwait starts seismic survey for more oil finds.
newsitem.headline: Kuwait starts seismic survey for more oil finds.

text.p: The state-owned Kuwait Oil Company (KOC) has started a seismic survey to search for more oil and gas reservoirs in several parts of the Gulf Arab state, an official said on Tuesday.
"The survey aims at exploring for more oil an gas reservoirs," said a KOC official. "It comes under efforts that would boost the (oil) production capacity."
Kuwait seeks to boost its production capacity to 3.5 million barrels per day in 2005 from a current capacity of about 2.5 million.
A KOC statement said: "The purpose of the project is to expand exploration work to find additional quantities of oil and gas."
"Work teams are conducting the survey in all desert areas and in the coming period the survey would start in residential areas."
The survey was one of KOC's "largest strategic projects," said the statement. KOC has said it is optimistic about finding more reserves in Kuwait oil fields.
